name: CHEEDING
recent: Cheeding Holdings Berhad 于2026年9月29日召开第二次常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于2026年8月20日宣布每股0.3仙的中期单层股息，除息日为9月8日，派发日为9月25日。最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比下降35%，净利环比下降28%，但净利率由33.7%升至37.3%。
notable: 2026年9月29日第二次常年股东大会所有决议获股东通过。
宣布每股0.3仙中期单层股息，除息日2026年9月8日，派发日2026年9月25日。

risks: 独立非执行董事Chang Poh Sheng于2025年10月7日出售100,000股（0.013%）。
董事经理Ng Kian Chai于2025年10月7日出售3,000股间接权益。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为MYR 18,809,000，环比下降35%；净利为MYR 7,018,000，环比下降28%；净利率为37.3%，高于上季度的33.7%。

recent_en: Cheeding Holdings Berhad held its 2nd Annual General Meeting on 29 September 2026, with all resolutions passed. The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.3 sen per share on 20 August 2026, with ex-date on 8 September and payment on 25 September. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 35% QoQ and net profit fell 28% QoQ, while net margin rose from 33.7% to 37.3%.
notable_en: All resolutions were passed by shareholders at the 2nd AGM on 29 September 2026.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.3 sen per share, with ex-date on 8 September 2026 and payment date on 25 September 2026.
On 10 October 2026, announced changes in director and substantial shareholder Ng Kian Chai's interest, involving disposal of 3,000 shares (indirect interest).
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Chang Poh Sheng disposed 100,000 shares (0.013%) on 7 October 2025.
Managing Director Ng Kian Chai disposed 3,000 shares (indirect interest) on 7 October 2025.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 18,809,000, down 35% QoQ; net profit was MYR 7,018,000, down 28% QoQ; net margin was 37.3%, up from 33.7% in the previous quarter.
